metadata.name: Minimal Lens
metadata.description: The smallest valid Lens Manifest, demonstrating the required floor: the protocol version, the type marker, a name and semantic version, an (empty) interpretation policy, and a default Adaptation Policy. Everything else - including this description - is optional. An empty interpretation object means the engine applies its documented defaults; 'balanced' means the lens may evolve, but only through reviewed Lens Change Proposals.
